description.en: The ID of the agent runtime.
The business type of the bot.
The name of the IM bot. The system performs a case-insensitive substring search.
The page number. Must be greater than or equal to 1. Default: 1.
The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1–100. Default: 20.

descriptions.zh: GET /2025-09-10/agents/im-bots；200 OK；data 含 items、pageNumber、pageSize、total；pageNumber 默认 1、pageSize 默认 20、上限 100；可按 botName（子串忽略大小写）、agentRuntimeId、botBizType、status 筛选
descriptions.en: Send a GET request to the `/2025-09-10/agents/im-bots` endpoint to retrieve a paginated list of IM bots. Use the `botName`, `agentRuntimeId`, `botBizType`, and `status` query parameters to filter the results. For pagination, the `pageNumber` defaults to 1 and the `pageSize` defaults to 20, with a maximum of 100.
